reasons: The code is one long line, which makes review and debugging hard.
No tests or other evidence of behavior are visible.

terms.meaning: The measured details of a parcel taken during a land survey.
The result of one verification check, such as a potential issue or a pass.

sections.name: File setup, SurveyPage
sections.title: Survey record page in one block
sections.what: Draws the survey record, filters the verification results to potential issues, and shows an empty message when no survey record exists.
sections.why: Puts the measurements next to the checks that flagged a problem.
sections.watch_out: The whole page sits on one long line, so a small edit can break it without a clear error.

summary: Shows the survey record for the case and the verification issues flagged as potential problems.
purpose: Lets the user see the survey measurements next to the issues that need review.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the filtering of issues to potential problems only.
how: Reads the survey record and the verification results. If there is no survey record, it shows an empty message. Otherwise it shows the survey card and a discrepancy card for each potential issue, with translated comparison labels.
inputs: The survey record and verification results from the case, plus the chosen language.
outputs: A page with a survey card, discrepancy cards, or an empty message.
risks: The whole page is a single long line in the packet, so the full logic cannot be checked from these notes and edits are hard to make safely.
debug: If the page is blank, check that the case has a survey record. If no issues appear, check that verification results use the potential issue outcome value. If labels are wrong, check the comparison labels.
